description.ncbi_summary: Predicted to enable GTPase regulator activity. Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of inflammatory response. Predicted to act upstream of or within positive regulation of cytokine production involved in inflammatory response and positive regulation of leukocyte chemotaxis. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm and plasma membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Apr 2022]

uniprot_function.text: Interacts with subunit of G(i) alpha proteins and regulates the activation of G(i) alpha proteins.
